运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

两种前向的输出和全部参数梯度一致；checkpoint 路径的逻辑保存字节更少。数字用于解释机制，不宣称 GPU 节省比例。

python 43_memory-checkpointing_demo.py环境配置

观察重计算减少的保存量，并逐参数核对梯度

43_memory-checkpointing_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint torch.manual_seed(32)# STEP 1: 两次运行使用同一个模型和同一数据，不进行参数更新block = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.GELU(),                      nn.Linear(128, 128), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(128, 16))x = torch.randn(32, 64)target = torch.randn(32, 16) # STEP 2: hook 统计为反向保存的逻辑字节；这不是 GPU 峰值def run(use_checkpoint):    block.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    local_x = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)    saved_bytes = []    def pack(tensor):        saved_bytes.append(tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size())        return tensor    def unpack(tensor):        return tensor    with torch.autograd.graph.saved_tensors_hooks(pack, unpack):        if use_checkpoint:            output = checkpoint(block, local_x, use_reentrant=False)        else:            output = block(local_x)        loss = (output - target).square().mean()    loss.backward()    grads = [p.grad.detach().clone() for p in block.parameters()]    return output.detach(), grads, sum(saved_bytes) # STEP 3: 节省保存量的同时，应保留目标计算与梯度plain, grad_plain, bytes_plain = run(False)remat, grad_remat, bytes_remat = run(True)torch.testing.assert_close(plain, remat)for a, b in zip(grad_plain, grad_remat):    torch.testing.assert_close(a, b)assert bytes_remat < bytes_plainprint('普通前向逻辑保存字节:', bytes_plain)print('重计算逻辑保存字节:', bytes_remat)print('通过：输出和参数梯度一致；此数值不是 CUDA 峰值显存')
